<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="10.6 15.35 938.79 459.79">
  <style>
    @keyframes tick {
      0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      25% { transform: rotate(90deg); }
      50% { transform: rotate(180deg); }
      75% { transform: rotate(270deg); }
      100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }
    @keyframes travel {
      0% { transform: translateX(0); }
      100% { transform: translateX(560px); }
    }
    @keyframes travelFast {
      0% { transform: translateX(0); }
      100% { transform: translateX(560px); }
    }
    @keyframes blink {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
      50% { opacity: 0.3; }
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Left computer -->
  <g id="computer">
    <!-- monitor body -->
    <rect x="70" y="250" width="180" height="130" rx="10" fill="#6B7785" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3.5"/>
    <!-- screen -->
    <rect x="88" y="266" width="144" height="98" rx="6" fill="#3D8FD1" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3"/>
    <!-- screen glow lines -->
    <line x1="104" y1="292" x2="216" y2="292" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.5"/>
    <line x1="104" y1="312" x2="196" y2="312" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.4"/>
    <line x1="104" y1="332" x2="206" y2="332" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.3"/>
    <!-- stand -->
    <rect x="145" y="380" width="30" height="24" fill="#6B7785" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3"/>
    <!-- base -->
    <rect x="110" y="404" width="100" height="12" rx="5" fill="#6B7785" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3"/>
    <!-- back computer hint (right computer, same group) -->
    <rect x="710" y="250" width="180" height="130" rx="10" fill="#6B7785" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3.5"/>
    <rect x="728" y="266" width="144" height="98" rx="6" fill="#3D8FD1" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="744" y1="292" x2="856" y2="292" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.5"/>
    <line x1="744" y1="312" x2="836" y2="312" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.4"/>
    <line x1="744" y1="332" x2="846" y2="332" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.3"/>
    <rect x="785" y="380" width="30" height="24" fill="#6B7785" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3"/>
    <rect x="750" y="404" width="100" height="12" rx="5" fill="#6B7785" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Computer label -->
  

  <!-- Dotted line between computers -->
  <g id="dotted-line">
    <line x1="260" y1="315" x2="700" y2="315" stroke="#3D8FD1" stroke-width="6" stroke-dasharray="4 22" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- arrowhead -->
    <polygon points="700,300 730,315 700,330" fill="#3D8FD1" stroke="#3D8FD1" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <!-- travelling dot -->
    <circle cx="260" cy="315" r="10" fill="#F2B33D" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="2">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;1" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
  </g>

  <!-- Clock above middle -->
  <g id="clock">
    <!-- clock body -->
    <circle cx="480" cy="140" r="65" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="4"/>
    <!-- tick marks -->
    <line x1="480" y1="82" x2="480" y2="92" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="480" y1="188" x2="480" y2="178" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="422" y1="140" x2="432" y2="140" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="538" y1="140" x2="528" y2="140" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- hour hand -->
    <line x1="480" y1="140" x2="480" y2="105" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- minute hand - ticks -->
    <g style="transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: 480px 140px;">
      <line x1="480" y1="140" x2="480" y2="95" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round">
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 480 140" to="360 480 140" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </line>
    </g>
    <!-- center dot -->
    <circle cx="480" cy="140" r="6" fill="#E0663A" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Clock label -->
  

  <!-- Fast state: green line, fast dot -->
  <g id="fast">
    <line x1="260" y1="315" x2="700" y2="315" stroke="#3FA66B" stroke-width="6" stroke-dasharray="4 22" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0" dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </line>
    <circle cx="260" cy="315" r="10" fill="#3FA66B" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="2" opacity="0">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0" dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
  </g>

  <!-- Slow state: dark red line, slow dot -->
  <g id="slow">
    <line x1="260" y1="315" x2="700" y2="315" stroke="#8B1A1A" stroke-width="6" stroke-dasharray="4 22" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0" dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </line>
    <circle cx="260" cy="315" r="10" fill="#8B1A1A" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="2" opacity="0">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;0" dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
  </g>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="62.96 106.46 676.59 595.09">
  <style>
    @keyframes swing {
      0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
      50% { transform: rotate(-13deg); }
      100% { transform: rotate(0deg); }
    }
    #arm { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: 0% 60%; animation: swing 5s ease-in-out infinite; }
    @keyframes spin { from { transform: rotate(0deg); } to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
    #platter-spin { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; animation: spin 7s linear infinite; }
    @keyframes travel { 0% { transform: translate(0,0); } 50% { transform: translate(-28px,-18px); } 100% { transform: translate(0,0); } }
    #head-move { transform-box: fill-box; animation: travel 5s ease-in-out infinite; }
  </style>

  <!-- base chassis -->
  <g id="chassis">
    <rect x="110" y="150" width="580" height="500" rx="42" fill="#E9D8B4" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="4"/>
    <rect x="110" y="150" width="580" height="500" rx="42" fill="none" stroke="#6B7785" stroke-width="4" transform="translate(6,8)"/>
  </g>

  <!-- platter -->
  <g id="platter">
    <circle cx="400" cy="400" r="205" fill="#C9CFD6" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="4"/>
    <g id="platter-spin">
      <circle cx="400" cy="400" r="175" fill="#B7BEC7" stroke="#6B7785" stroke-width="3"/>
      <circle cx="400" cy="400" r="130" fill="#C9CFD6" stroke="#6B7785" stroke-width="3"/>
      <circle cx="400" cy="400" r="80" fill="#B7BEC7" stroke="#6B7785" stroke-width="3"/>
      <circle cx="400" cy="400" r="205" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.55"/>
      <path d="M400 225 A175 175 0 0 1 566 315" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>
      <path d="M400 575 A175 175 0 0 1 234 485" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>
    </g>
    <!-- spindle -->
    <circle cx="400" cy="400" r="42" fill="#E9D8B4" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="4"/>
    <circle cx="400" cy="400" r="20" fill="#6B7785" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="4"/>
    <circle cx="400" cy="400" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- arm -->
  <g id="arm">
    <path d="M400 400 L186 366 L156 402 L186 438 Z" fill="#3D8FD1" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <circle cx="400" cy="400" r="34" fill="#3D8FD1" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="4"/>
    <circle cx="400" cy="400" r="13" fill="#E9D8B4" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3"/>
    <g id="head-move">
      <g id="read-and-write-head">
        <rect x="118" y="378" width="42" height="26" rx="9" fill="#F2B33D" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="4"/>
        <rect x="106" y="382" width="16" height="18" rx="6" fill="#E0663A" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3"/>
        <circle cx="109" cy="391" r="3.5" fill="#1F2A37"/>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- platter label -->
  

  <!-- head label -->
  

  <!-- arm label -->
  
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="104.12 146.12 551.76 449.76">
  <style>
    .cell-bob { animation: bob 4s ease-in-out infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; }
    @keyframes bob {
      0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); }
      50% { transform: translateY(-10px); }
    }
    .hb-a { animation: drift 3s ease-in-out infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; }
    .hb-b { animation: drift 3.6s ease-in-out infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; animation-delay: -1.2s; }
    .hb-c { animation: drift 3.2s ease-in-out infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; animation-delay: -2s; }
    @keyframes drift {
      0%,100% { transform: translate(0,0); }
      50% { transform: translate(5px,-3px); }
    }
  </style>

  <g id="red-blood-cell">
    <g class="cell-bob">
      <ellipse cx="380" cy="380" rx="240" ry="180" fill="#D9577A" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="4"/>
      <ellipse cx="380" cy="360" rx="240" ry="180" fill="#E0663A"/>
      <ellipse cx="380" cy="372" rx="220" ry="162" fill="#E0663A"/>
      <ellipse cx="380" cy="380" rx="110" ry="78" fill="#F2A88C"/>
      <ellipse cx="380" cy="380" rx="110" ry="78" fill="none" stroke="#D9577A" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.5"/>
      <ellipse cx="340" cy="300" rx="70" ry="40" fill="#F2B33D" opacity="0.25"/>
      <g id="hemoglobin">
        <g class="hb-a">
          <circle cx="320" cy="430" r="16" fill="#8C6BC8" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="4"/>
        </g>
        <g class="hb-b">
          <circle cx="450" cy="440" r="14" fill="#8C6BC8" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="4"/>
        </g>
        <g class="hb-c">
          <circle cx="390" cy="470" r="12" fill="#8C6BC8" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="4"/>
        </g>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>

  
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="59.44 -38.56 957.71 627.11">
  <style>
    @keyframes drip {
      0% { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; }
      80% { transform: translateY(180px); opacity: 1; }
      100% { transform: translateY(180px); opacity: 0; }
    }
    @keyframes bag-pulse {
      0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
      50% { transform: scale(1.02); }
    }
    .droplet { animation: drip 2.5s ease-in infinite; }
    .bag { animation: bag-pulse 3s ease-in-out infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center bottom; }
  </style>

  <!-- Blood bag -->
  <g id="blood-bag">
    <!-- Bag outline -->
    <rect x="120" y="40" width="160" height="200" rx="24" ry="24" fill="#E9D8B4" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3.5"/>
    <!-- Blood inside bag -->
    <rect x="130" y="70" width="140" height="160" rx="18" ry="18" fill="#D9577A"/>
    <!-- Lighter highlight on blood -->
    <rect x="138" y="78" width="124" height="60" rx="12" ry="12" fill="#E0663A" opacity="0.5"/>
    <!-- Bag hanger ring -->
    <circle cx="200" cy="32" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3.5"/>
    <!-- Bag port at bottom -->
    <rect x="185" y="238" width="30" height="16" rx="4" ry="4" fill="#6B7785" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Tubing and drip chamber -->
  <g id="tubing">
    <!-- Drip chamber -->
    <ellipse cx="200" cy="280" rx="16" ry="22" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3"/>
    <!-- Tube path down and to the right -->
    <path d="M200,302 L200,360 Q200,400 240,420 L400,460 Q440,470 460,490 L500,520" fill="none" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- Tube highlight -->
    <path d="M200,302 L200,360 Q200,400 240,420 L400,460 Q440,470 460,490 L500,520" fill="none" stroke="#F4F1EA" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.6"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Arm -->
  <g id="arm">
    <!-- Arm main shape -->
    <path d="M500,520 Q520,500 560,490 Q650,470 750,440 Q820,420 860,400 Q900,380 920,360 
             Q930,350 928,340 Q924,328 910,330 Q880,336 840,355 Q780,380 700,400 
             Q620,420 560,440 Q520,450 500,470 Q480,490 478,510 Q476,525 490,528 Z" fill="#E9D8B4" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <!-- Arm inner shading -->
    <path d="M510,515 Q540,495 600,478 Q690,452 780,422 Q830,408 870,390 Q900,376 915,362 
             Q922,356 920,348 Q916,340 905,342 Q880,348 845,362 Q785,385 700,408 
             Q620,428 560,448 Q530,458 510,475 Q498,488 496,505 Q496,515 510,515 Z" fill="#F4F1EA" opacity="0.5"/>
    <!-- Hand outline -->
    <path d="M920,360 Q940,350 950,340 Q958,332 955,322 Q950,310 938,316 Q925,324 910,332" fill="#E9D8B4" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <!-- IV site on arm -->
    <circle cx="560" cy="488" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <circle cx="560" cy="488" r="3" fill="#D9577A"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Droplet animation -->
  <g id="droplet">
    <circle cx="200" cy="310" r="7" fill="#D9577A" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="1.5" class="droplet"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Additional droplets - staggered -->
  <g id="droplet2">
    <circle cx="200" cy="310" r="5" fill="#D9577A" opacity="0.7" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="1.5" class="droplet" style="animation-delay: 1.2s"/>
  </g>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="155.72 7.72 688.56 566.56">
  <style>
    .pop { animation: pop 5s ease-in-out infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; }
    @keyframes pop {
      0%, 12% { transform: translate(0,0) scale(1); opacity: 1; }
      22% { transform: translate(6px,-34px) scale(0.7); opacity: 0; }
      30%, 100% { transform: translate(0,0) scale(1); opacity: 1; }
    }
    .pop2 { animation: pop 5s ease-in-out infinite; animation-delay: 2.5s; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; }
    .sign { animation: sign 4s ease-in-out infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: bottom center; }
    @keyframes sign {
      0%, 100% { transform: rotate(-2deg); }
      50% { transform: rotate(2deg); }
    }
  </style>

  <!-- shop body -->

    <line x1="345" y1="230" x2="345" y2="340" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="270" y1="285" x2="420" y2="285" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3"/>
    <rect x="470" y="230" width="150" height="110" rx="8" fill="#3D8FD1" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="4"/>
    <line x1="545" y1="230" x2="545" y2="340" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="470" y1="285" x2="620" y2="285" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M250 480 h480" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="4"/>
    <rect x="650" y="200" width="60" height="240" rx="8" fill="#F2B33D" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="4"/>

    <path d="M240 150 L720 110 L720 150 L240 190 Z" fill="#3FA66B" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- sign on roof -->
  <g id="sign" class="sign">
    <rect x="390" y="52" width="180" height="60" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="4"/>
    <ellipse cx="445" cy="82" rx="18" ry="24" fill="#F4F1EA" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3"/>
    <ellipse cx="510" cy="82" rx="18" ry="24" fill="#F2B33D" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3"/>
    <rect x="470" y="112" width="20" height="34" fill="#6B7785" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- counter in front -->
  <g id="counter">
    <rect x="200" y="410" width="600" height="60" rx="8" fill="#E0663A" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="4"/>

    <rect x="230" y="470" width="40" height="60" fill="#8C6BC8" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="4"/>
    <rect x="740" y="470" width="40" height="60" fill="#8C6BC8" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="4"/>
  </g>

  <!-- eggs -->
  <g id="eggs">
    <g class="pop">
      <ellipse cx="350" cy="380" rx="20" ry="26" fill="#F4F1EA" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3"/>

    <ellipse cx="530" cy="388" rx="20" ry="26" fill="#F4F1EA" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3"/>

    <ellipse cx="410" cy="345" rx="20" ry="26" fill="#F4F1EA" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3"/>
    <ellipse cx="530" cy="345" rx="20" ry="26" fill="#F2B33D" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- crates -->

  <!-- eggs label -->
  
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="67.24 -7.76 875.52 615.52" font-family="sans-serif">
  <style>
    .pulse { animation: pulse 1.8s ease-out infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; }
    .p2 { animation-delay: .6s; }
    .p3 { animation-delay: 1.2s; }
    @keyframes pulse {
      0% { transform: scale(1); opacity: .9; }
      50% { transform: scale(1.35); opacity: .6; }
      100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: .9; }
    }
    .bolt { animation: flicker 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; }
    @keyframes flicker {
      0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
      45% { transform: scale(1.12); }
      55% { transform: scale(.96); }
    }
    .wave { stroke-dasharray: 420; animation: sweep 3.2s linear infinite; }
    @keyframes sweep {
      0% { stroke-dashoffset: 420; }
      70% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
      100% { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Hub arrows -->
  <g stroke="#6B7785" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <g class="pulse">
      <line x1="330" y1="220" x2="255" y2="150"/>
    </g>
    <g class="pulse p2">
      <line x1="500" y1="300" x2="500" y2="400"/>
    </g>
    <g class="pulse p3">
      <line x1="670" y1="220" x2="760" y2="150"/>
    </g>
    <polygon points="248,143 272,158 252,168" fill="#6B7785" stroke="none"/>
    <polygon points="488,408 512,408 500,432" fill="#6B7785" stroke="none"/>
    <polygon points="768,143 758,175 742,160" fill="#6B7785" stroke="none"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Hub circle -->
  <g id="hub">
    <circle cx="500" cy="240" r="112" fill="#E9D8B4" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="4"/>
    <circle cx="500" cy="240" r="96" fill="#F4F1EA" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="3"/>
    <text x="500" y="228" text-anchor="middle" font-size="44" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2A37">Epilepsy</text>
    <text x="500" y="276" text-anchor="middle" font-size="44" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2A37">Syndrome</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Seizures icon -->
  <g id="seizures">
    <circle cx="195" cy="120" r="72" fill="#F2B33D" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="4"/>
    <g class="bolt">
      <polygon points="205,64 172,120 193,120 185,162 222,104 200,104" fill="#E0663A" stroke="#1F2A37" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    </g>
  </g>
